headings.usage: Screen titles, Settings headers, Large empty states. (Use system font fallback if custom fonts aren't loaded)

mono.usage: The actual 6/8 digit TOTP codes. CRITICAL: Use letterSpacing (tracking) for readability

glassmorphism.rules: All cards and floating headers MUST use BlurView. Never use solid grey. Always add a 1px inner border of rgba(255,255,255,0.1) to define the edge.

neumorphism.rules: Use for the lock screen PIN pad. Subtle drop shadow and inner highlight to make buttons look like tactile, physical keys on a premium safe.

gradients.usage: Use a subtle gradient from #00F0FF to #7B61FF for the circular progress timer and primary CTA buttons. Do NOT use generic gradients for backgrounds.

layouts_and_grids.system: 8pt grid system. All margins and paddings must be multiples of 8 (8, 16, 24, 32, 48).
layouts_and_grids.touch_targets: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, list items) MUST have a minimum height/width of 48px for accessibility.
layouts_and_grids.bento_cards: Use varying heights for pinned favorites vs standard list items. Pinned favorites should be larger bento-style cards. List items should be generous, padding 24px.

components.name: VaultCard
components.structure: BlurView container with rounded corners (24px). Top row: Service Logo + Name. Middle: Massive TOTP digits. Right side/corner: Circular countdown timer. Bottom: Copy to clipboard button (pill shaped).
components.interaction: On press 'Copy', trigger HapticFeedback.selectionAsync() and show a custom Toast.

components.name: NeonScanner
components.structure: Camera view filling the screen. Overlay is a dark semi-transparent view with a clear cutout in the center. The cutout has 4 corner brackets (svg) colored #00F0FF with a neon drop shadow.

components.name: GlassInput
components.description: Text input for manual entry and search.
components.structure: TextInput inside a BlurView wrapper. Placeholder text should be muted. Active state increases the border opacity.

components.name: CircularTimer
components.structure: react-native-svg Circle with strokeDashoffset animated via react-native-reanimated based on the remaining seconds. Use LinearGradient for the stroke.

motion.rules: Micro-animations are mandatory. Scale down buttons slightly (scale: 0.95) on press-in, spring back on press-out. Smoothly animate the circular timer using withTiming. Fade in the list items sequentially on mount.

accessibility.haptics: Use expo-haptics extensively. 'Impact.Light' for typing PIN/search, 'Notification.Success' when copying a code, 'Impact.Medium' for scanner success.
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Pure white on #050505 is excellent.
accessibility.test_ids: Every TouchableOpacity, TextInput, and primary Text MUST have a testID (React Native equivalent of data-testid) mapped to its role, e.g., testID='copy-code-button'.

image_urls.description: Sleek, dark curved metallic surfaces indicating high-end security and physical vault.

media.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons or Feather) for system icons. For service logos (Google, Github, Discord), use MaterialCommunityIcons.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Expo React Native app. Do NOT use HTML/CSS elements (no div, span, className). Use standard RN View, Text, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity, etc. in your .js files.
Use expo-blur for ALL card backgrounds to achieve the glassmorphism effect.
Use react-native-reanimated for the circular timer and button press animations.
Use expo-linear-gradient for the timer ring stroke and primary active buttons.
Ensure 'react-native-svg' is used for the countdown timer circle.
For the UI, do not use basic solid gray backgrounds for cards. Always layer a BlurView over the absolute black #050505 background to create depth.
Implement a custom Toast using Reanimated (slide down from top) instead of the default native alert.
Implement the UI explicitly with React Native components; handle styles via StyleSheet.create.
All interactive elements MUST include the testID attribute (e.g., testID='submit-btn').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not make standard, flat layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects extensively for a premium feel.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - press states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than typical). Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute.
NEVER use complete transparent background on headers or overlays. Always use BlurView.
Do not use generic gray or pure black gradients. Use subtle blue/purple tints.
